change.source: finding F5 (a record change that fails resends read and writes the line of a due message again; at least once is not documented): docs/design/bridge.md, CHANGELOG.md and AGENTS.md say the read is sent at least once; the line of a due message is written only once its entry is recorded due; case a_read_without_an_answer_or_without_its_record_change_marks_nothing_and_is_sent_again, red under the mutant (the line written before the record change)
